sentences.en: That's real life.
sentences.zh: 这就是现实生活。

sentences.zh: 为什么谋杀率上升了？

sentences.en: So we talked to a lot of people in Baltimore about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们和巴尔的摩的许多人谈过这件事。

sentences.en: Police officers, former and current, residents, adults and kids.
sentences.zh: 警察，前任和现任，居民，成年人和孩子。

sentences.en: Even drug dealers.
sentences.zh: 甚至毒贩。

sentences.en: In my opinion, everybody's carrying a gun.

sentences.en: Everybody's angry.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在生气。

sentences.en: Everybody's mad.

sentences.en: You know, remember, you don't have any places for young people to go.
sentences.zh: 你知道，记住，你们没有给年轻人提供去的地方。

sentences.en: When you don't provide proper relief for these kids, and the only thing they're doing is drinking or smoking reefer, getting high,
sentences.zh: 当你没有为这些孩子提供适当的宣泄途径，而他们唯一在做的事就是喝酒或抽大麻、嗨大麻时，

sentences.en: bad things are going to happen.
sentences.zh: 坏事就会发生。

sentences.en: One theory was this kind of socioeconomic explanation.
sentences.zh: 其中一种理论是这种社会经济解释。

sentences.en: That this was really about generational poverty and drug addiction.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是关于代际贫困和毒品上瘾。

sentences.en: But those things hadn't changed.
sentences.zh: 但这些事情并没有改变。

sentences.en: Baltimore wasn't any poorer after Freddie Gray than it had been before.
sentences.zh: 弗雷迪·格雷事件后，巴尔的摩并没有比以前更穷。

sentences.en: The cops definitely pulled back.
sentences.zh: 警察肯定退缩了。

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to be the next cop that makes an arrest and the arrest goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 没有人想成为下一个进行逮捕却把逮捕搞砸的警察。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 拜托。

sentences.en: The cops pulled back.
sentences.zh: 警察退缩了。

sentences.en: Other people thought it was because the police had pulled back.
sentences.zh: 其他人认为这是因为警察退缩了。

sentences.en: That maybe they were just sort of reticent to make arrests with a federal investigation going on.
sentences.zh: 也许他们在联邦调查进行期间对逮捕有些犹豫不决。

sentences.en: All I really remember around that time, it really was no police out there.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个时候真正的情况是，外面根本没有警察。

sentences.en: That's all I swear to God.
sentences.zh: 我对上帝发誓，就是这样。

sentences.en: I gave it like a good two months to three months.
sentences.zh: 我给了它大约两到三个月的时间。

sentences.en: And finally, there was this idea that people were taking advantage of this moment when the police were really distracted.
sentences.zh: 最后，人们有一种想法，即人们正在利用警察真正分心的这一时刻。

sentences.en: The criminals, they exploited the hell out of Freddie Gray.
sentences.zh: 罪犯们狠狠地利用了弗雷迪·格雷事件。

sentences.en: They made a lot of money selling dope on these streets because they were allowed to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们在这些街道上卖毒品赚了很多钱，因为他们被允许这样做。

sentences.en: The killers, the hitmen, they made a lot of money killing people.
sentences.zh: 杀手，职业杀手，他们通过杀人赚了很多钱。

sentences.en: A lot of money been made killing people.
sentences.zh: 杀人赚了很多钱。

sentences.en: That's why?
sentences.zh: 这就是原因吗？

sentences.en: Because you ain't going to jail for it.
sentences.zh: 因为你不会因此入狱。

sentences.en: You can get away with it.
sentences.zh: 你能逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: And you're more likely, if you get away with it once, get away with it twice, you're more than likely to kill again.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你逃脱了一次，逃脱了两次，你很有可能会再次杀人。

sentences.en: Criminals got more emboldened.
sentences.zh: 罪犯变得更加嚣张了。

sentences.en: And that's the story we got from a lot of police officers, like Daryl D'Souza, who was police commissioner when we sat down with him.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们从许多警官那里得到的故事，比如达里尔·德苏扎，当我们与他坐在一起时，他是警察局长。

sentences.en: Why did they get emboldened?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们变得如此嚣张？

sentences.en: I think they were trying to take advantage of the unrest and the protests.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们试图利用骚乱和抗议活动。

sentences.en: I can say that the police officers, although they had anxiety about everything that was going on, the officers were doing their job, you know, faithfully.
sentences.zh: 我可以这样说，警官们虽然对发生的一切感到焦虑，但警官们一直在忠实地履行职责，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I just think that those folks that were the trigger pullers and those that were creating harm in the community, they just tried to take advantage of a storm that was going on.
sentences.zh: 但我只是认为那些扣动扳机的人和在社区中制造伤害的人，他们只是试图利用正在发生的一场风暴。

sentences.en: So what he's saying is the police were trying their best, but the criminals were just out of control.
sentences.zh: 所以他的意思是警察已经尽力了，但罪犯简直失控了。

sentences.en: But that's not exactly what the numbers show.
sentences.zh: 但数字显示的情况并非完全如此。

sentences.en: The numbers show that the police were arresting way fewer people.
sentences.zh: 数字显示，警察逮捕的人数要少得多。

sentences.en: Arrests were down by nearly a third in 2015, and even more the next year.
sentences.zh: 2015年的逮捕人数下降了近三分之一，第二年下降得更多。

sentences.en: So think about this just for a minute.
sentences.zh: 所以只要想一想。

sentences.en: People said they decided to take a knee.
sentences.zh: 人们说他们决定屈膝。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is, they decided to get away from this aggressive policing, and it looked like they were taking a knee,
sentences.zh: 事实是，他们决定摆脱这种侵略性执法，这看起来像是他们在屈膝，

sentences.en: when in reality, the DOJ was in here monitoring the police department.
sentences.zh: 而现实中，司法部正在这里监督警察局。

sentences.en: They were doing research.
sentences.zh: 他们在做调查研究。

sentences.en: They were doing a study.
sentences.zh: 他们在做一项研究。

sentences.en: So policing was really, probably moving towards being done in the right way.
sentences.zh: 所以警务工作实际上可能正朝着正确的方式迈进。

sentences.en: Remember, this was a moment when the Baltimore Police Department was under intense scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是一个巴尔的摩警察局处于严密审查之下的时刻。

sentences.en: There are these federal investigators there pouring over everything.
sentences.zh: 有这些联邦调查人员在那里仔细审查一切。

sentences.en: looking for examples of unconstitutional policing.
sentences.zh: 寻找违宪执法的例子。

sentences.en: And the department realizes it has to change.
sentences.zh: 警察局意识到它必须改变。

sentences.en: It has to stop this practice of aggressive policing.
sentences.zh: 它必须停止这种侵略性执法的做法。

sentences.en: But it's done it for years.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经这样做好几年了。

sentences.en: And suddenly, the crime rate is spiking.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，犯罪率飙升。

sentences.en: Homicides are going through the roof.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案直线上升。

sentences.en: And the problem is, they don't know how to solve it without those old tactics, without the aggressive policing.
sentences.zh: 问题是，如果没有那些老战术，没有那种侵略性执法，他们不知道该如何解决这个问题。

sentences.en: So what they discover is, what Baltimore discovers is, they actually don't know how to police in the right way.
sentences.zh: 所以他们发现的是，巴尔的摩发现的是，他们实际上不知道如何以正确的方式进行警务工作。

sentences.en: It's not that they don't care, or that they weren't trying.
sentences.zh: 并不是他们不在乎，也不是他们没有努力。

sentences.en: It's just that they didn't know how.
sentences.zh: 只是他们不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: To the criminal element, and also to the normal eye, it looked like taking a knee, because they had been at 100 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 对于犯罪分子以及普通人的眼光来说，这看起来像是屈膝，因为他们以前是以100英里的时速在干。

sentences.en: Now they were going at 50, which is where they should have been anyway.
sentences.zh: 现在他们以50英里的时速行驶，这本来就是他们应该处的位置。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is, they were heading towards this retaliatory cycle of gang hitting gang, a shooting on the west side, ended up in a shooting on the east side.
sentences.zh: 事实是，他们正朝着帮派打击帮派的报复性循环迈进，西区的一起枪击案，最终导致东区的一起枪击案。

sentences.en: We're heading towards that trend anyway.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们都在朝着那个趋势发展。

sentences.en: And what exacerbated that is that police who had never known how to police the right way didn't know what to do,
sentences.zh: 加剧这种情况的是，那些从未懂得如何正确执法的警察不知道该做什么，

sentences.en: didn't know how to police adequately.
sentences.zh: 不知道如何充分地进行警务工作。

sentences.en: And then the spike continued.
sentences.zh: 然后激增仍在继续。

sentences.en: It sounds like what you're saying is that somewhere along the way, the police department in Baltimore
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是，在某个时候，巴尔的摩的警察局

sentences.en: forgot how to actually police.
sentences.zh: 忘记了如何真正地执法。

sentences.en: That's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 这正是发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, police saying that we could stop this spike if you let us police, essentially in an unconstitutional manner, because they didn't know how to police anymore
sentences.zh: 是的，警察说，如果我们让你执法，本质上以违宪的方式执法，我们就能阻止这种激增，因为他们不再知道如何执法了

sentences.en: because they had been doing it wrong for so long.
sentences.zh: 因为他们长久以来一直用错误的方式在做。

sentences.en: So the only way they knew how to correct this is to go back to the dragnet method, which was unconstitutional, which led to Freddie Gray.
sentences.zh: 所以他们纠正这一问题的唯一方法就是回到大网捕鱼的方法，这是违宪的，这导致了弗雷迪·格雷事件。

sentences.en: So you got this mix of chaos going on.
sentences.zh: 所以你遇到了这种混乱的组合。

sentences.en: The DOJ was saying, no, you can stop the spike, but do it constitutionally.
sentences.zh: 司法部说，不，你可以阻止激增，但要以合宪的方式去做。

sentences.en: So you had that mixed up.
sentences.zh: 所以你有了这种混杂的情况。

sentences.en: Oh, it's Freddie Gray.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是弗雷迪·格雷。

sentences.en: You have this explosion, and the police don't know how to control it, and it's right because they want to control it and it meant that the DOJ and everyone else
sentences.zh: 你经历了这场大爆发，警察不知道如何控制它，这很正常，因为他们想要控制它，这意味着司法部和其他所有人

sentences.en: say you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 都说你不能那样做。

sentences.en: That's unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 那是违宪的。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what the DOJ found.
sentences.zh: 这正是司法部发现的。

sentences.en: The result of its investigation, in August 2016, a little more than a year after the death of Freddie Gray,
sentences.zh: 2016年8月，在弗雷迪·格雷死后一年多一点，其调查结果是，

sentences.en: was that the Baltimore Police Department had routinely violated civil rights, that it had been policing unconstitutionally.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩警察局例行侵犯公民权利，其执法是违宪的。

sentences.en: And in doing so, the DOJ found, it had, quote,
sentences.zh: 司法部发现，通过这样做，它，引述原话，

sentences.en: exacerbated community distrust of the police, particularly in the African-American community.
sentences.zh: 加剧了社区对警察的不信任，特别是在非裔美国人社区。

sentences.en: What every black in Baltimore City knows is that the Baltimore City Police Department is the most racist and corrupt organization.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩市的每一个黑人都知道，巴尔的摩市警察局是最种族主义和最腐败的组织。

sentences.en: Citizens know it, kids know it, older people know it, everybody knows it.
sentences.zh: 市民知道，孩子知道，老年人知道，每个人都知道。

sentences.en: You don't get that way overnight.
sentences.zh: 你不是一夜之间变成这样的。

sentences.en: Freddie Gray was just a flashpoint, you see.
sentences.zh: 你看，弗雷迪·格雷只是一个爆发点。

sentences.en: And the problem is, no one trusts us now.
sentences.zh: 问题是，现在没有人信任我们。
